Rationale_and_Source_Fields: Vannes: explicit bus ID 'line-xx-yy' in DGS commands (an, cn, dn). Haggle: integer IDs 1-54 for observer iMotes, 1-11418 for seen Bluetooth devices. Salzburg: 'trip' session IDs, 'cell_id', and 'pci' physical cell identities.

Vannes: (x, y) Cartesian coordinates in meters relative to reference area. Haggle: explicitly confirmed absent in README ('Do you have any location or speed data? The answer is no'). Salzburg: GPS coordinates (lat, long, ele in WGS84/meters).

Vannes: second-by-second position updates per bus; speed is derivable via delta pos / delta t. Haggle: no mobility/trajectory logs; encounters are recorded without movement vectors. Salzburg: continuous GPS trajectory per second, including dlong and dlat displacement deltas.

Vannes: derivable by computing pairwise Euclidean distance <= transmission range over time. Haggle: directly observed in .dat columns 2 & 3 as Unix epoch timestamps in seconds. Salzburg: derivable for vehicle-to-cell infrastructure contacts; ad-hoc vehicle-to-vehicle contacts not observed.

Vannes: derivable from contact start/end intervals under simulated transmission range. Haggle: directly derivable as end_time - start_time from .dat records. Salzburg: derivable for continuous cell dwell time.

Vannes: derivable via Euclidean distance sqrt((x1-x2)^2 + (y1-y2)^2). Haggle: not available; Bluetooth discovery is binary within radio range without distance telemetry. Salzburg: derivable along vehicle trajectory or between consecutive GPS points.

Vannes: no radio layer in raw dataset ('No radio transmission is assumed'); requires channel propagation model. Haggle: no signal strength/RSSI recorded in iMote traces. Salzburg: directly observed across 5 metrics: rsrq (dB), sinr (dB), signal (0-5), rssi (dBm), rsrp (dBm).

Vannes: not recorded; requires communication protocol simulation. Haggle: not recorded; only Bluetooth inquiry beaconing was logged. Salzburg: directly observed in 'datarate' column (measured in bits per second, e.g. 5.5 Mbps).
Absent across all raw traces. DTN bundle workloads and QoS priorities require synthetic traffic generation or scenario definition.
Buffer capacity and occupancy are routing node state variables, not logged in physical contact traces; requires node buffer simulation.
Haggle documentation notes hardware battery models (CR-2 950mAh / 2200mAh rechargeables), but no runtime voltage/percentage logs exist. Requires energy consumption modeling in simulation.

Vannes: directly observed churn via node birth ('an') and death ('dn') events across timetables. Haggle: derivable from active observation periods across .dat logs. Salzburg: directly observed during trip logging intervals.
Historical routing performance metric generated by routing algorithms (e.g. PRoPHET delivery predictability); not an environmental raw field.
